Hi Lina, I'm working on SLOTPLAN-102 (format_duration). The acceptance tests contradict each other: test_short_and_whole_hours expects format_duration(120) == '2h' but test_regression_issue_164 expects format_duration(120) == '2h 00m'. Which one is the intended spec? I recall the design review covered this edge case - could you clarify?

SLOTPLAN-103 blocker: the acceptance tests contradict each other on back-to-back (touching) intervals. test_back_to_back_and_empty expects merge_intervals([(600,660),(540,600)]) == [(540,660)] (merge), but test_regression_issue_309 expects the SAME input == [(540,600),(600,660)] (keep separate). (Same class of issue @luca flagged on subtract_intervals.)
